title: Apply sanitizeErrorMessage to branch-setup.mjs and resolve-tasks.mjs (close SEC-W-012-1 cross-cutting)
description:
TASK-033 closed SEC-W-012-1 in scripts/merge-task.mjs by introducing lib/sanitize-error.mjs and wrapping 6 stderr `e.message` interpolation sites. The architect-reviewer for TASK-033 audited the rest of the codebase and identified 6 additional `e.message` leak sites of the SAME class in two other CLI scripts:

- scripts/branch-setup.mjs lines 247, 303, 336 (3 sites)
- scripts/resolve-tasks.mjs lines 145, 167, 176 (3 sites — including the new TASK-028 console.warn at L145)

This task applies sanitizeErrorMessage(e) to all 6 sites. Same pattern as TASK-033. No new lib code, no new dependencies. After this lands, the leak class is fully closed across the project and the natural prerequisite for promoting LD-PAT-008 ('always sanitize stderr in plugin output') is met (third independent occurrence rule).
acceptance_criteria: All 6 identified sites in branch-setup.mjs (3) and resolve-tasks.mjs (3) replaced with sanitizeErrorMessage(e) calls; verify via grep returns ZERO matches in console.warn/error and stderr.write paths
Both files import sanitizeErrorMessage from '../lib/sanitize-error.mjs' at the top
All 187 baseline tests continue passing (pre-flight grep audit of tests/ for path-fragment assertions to confirm no test updates needed)
Net LOC delta < +10 across both scripts combined (just imports + replacing string templates)
Optional: 1 integration test per script asserting stderr doesn't leak paths when an error path is triggered
notes: 2026-05-02 — Merged into sprint-4 (8aa1bbb). Wrapped 7 stderr e.message sites: branch-setup.mjs (3), resolve-tasks.mjs (3), merge-sprint.mjs (1, scope-expanded mid-review). +2 net LOC across 3 files. Tests 187/187. SEC-W-012-1 fully closed across project. All 3 reviewers approve; security-auditor sec_w_012_1_closed=true.
